name: Sanguine Mend consumes the Crimson Scion instant-cast buff (#6452)
contract: Crimson Scion 806424's tooltip is 'Direct damage dealt now has a $h% chance to make your next Sanguine Mend within $806425d instant cast', so the 806425 buff it triggers must be spent by the next Sanguine Mend. 806425 is the native aura 108 instant modifier (MiscValue 10 SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME, BasePoints -101) over the nine Sanguine Mend ranks with SpellFamilyFlags 0x80000: 802310 (Rank 1) and 504079-504086 (Ranks 2-9). Without a consumer the buff stayed for its full 10 s (DurationIndex 1) and every mend in the window was instant (#6452, level 45 Fleshweaver). This scenario fixtures the buff with set_aura - the acquisition path (direct damage proccing 806424 at its own 10% chance) is covered by bloodmage-crimson-scion-instant-mend - and measures the cast time of 504086 with and without it. Expected before the fix: 806425 is still present after the mend, and 504086 stays instant. Expected after the fix: the successful mend removes 806425, and the next cast has its normal cast time again (CastingTimeIndex 19; bloodmage-crimson-scion-instant-mend pins it at >= 2000 ms unbuffed).
